svg.title: fingerprint-from-image pipeline
svg.desc: A hand photo gets 21 learned landmarks and five upright fingertip crops; the index fingertip is enhanced, encoded into a unit embedding, and matched against an enrolled gallery by cosine similarity (best match 0.94).
